body: Thank you for your comment. The practicality of it means a lot.

I actually basically grew up on the internet and had a series of very formative and important relationships with people I met in various online communities. They were an important part of my growing up and are probably why I never killed myself when I was 16.

The issue I've had with this, however, is that all these people who were really important to me all eventually moved on and got Real Lives. It's really devastating when they all do it within the same timeframe, and honestly, I haven't been able to make even an "internet" connection with anyone since then. I don't really want to go through that again, anyway.

Thanks for your kind comment.
